note: ranges and defaults of convert.py / stream.py; hard limits (the format or the board cannot do it) stop with an error, recommended ranges only warn; the board's numbers (clock, flash, drawing cycles) are in its board.json (--board)

screen.note: hard: the players refuse anything bigger

flash.note: frames in flash (output/*.h), played by video::FlashPlayer

stream.note: frames stay on the computer (in output/*.h, after #if 0), stream.py sends them to video::StreamPlayer; the board only has the size and the path (output/*.h); palette 256 works (the board keeps it in RAM taken at run time, 2 bytes a color), but warns
